site_name: Stargate Abilene (Crusoe data center campus at the Lancium Clean Campus)
operator: Crusoe (developer/operator) on Lancium's campus; capacity leased to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for OpenAI
serving_utility: AEP Texas (transmission/delivery utility, ERCOT); retail supplier not identified
load_basis: Epoch AI estimate: 206 MW IT with Buildings 1-2 operational (Bldg 1 Sep 26 2025, Bldg 2 Dec 24 2025). Built capacity, not full build-out.
notes: Utility: the substation contractor (Mortenson) says transmission-line and interconnection work was done 'in coordination with AEP'; it built a 200 MW 138 kV substation (2022-2024) and a 1 GW 345 kV substation (first transformer energized Dec 19 2025, fully energized Mar 10 2026). Lancium describes the campus as grid connected with a 1.2 GW interconnect approved by ERCOT (https://lancium.com/locations-abilene/). The source says 'AEP', not 'AEP Texas' by name, and no source found names the retail electric provider or contract, so arrangement is left unknown. On-site gas generation is being added (Epoch: five turbines in place Sep 2025; on-site plant looked complete Mar 2026), so part of the load is or will be behind the meter. Year: Crusoe (Sep 30 2025) says the first phase is live and the first two buildings were energized. Planned figure is the 1.2 GW interconnect; Epoch projects 824 MW IT across eight buildings. Coordinates are the OpenStreetMap 'Lancium Clean Campus' polygon centroid (published address 5502 Spinks Rd only geocoded to the road). Method note: the web-search budget for this run was exhausted before this batch, so verification used direct fetches of known public pages (operator, utility, city and regulator documents, Epoch AI directory pages and the sources they cite); datacenterdynamics.com returned 403 and was not used.
